newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 17.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Government employees' pensions will be tax free in certain fixed amounts.
Grand Justices meeting decides to seek President Lee Teng-hui's opinion on question of whether vice-president can concurrently serve as premier.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Prosecutors continue to investigate land-related scandal in central city of Taichung.
Investigation Bureau finds Taiwan businessman spied for China.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui says "two-into-one" business tax merger plan to take effect from 1998.
Cabinet seeks ways to release huge amounts of state-owned shares.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwanese businessman suspected spying for China.
Central bank decides to let local firms borrow money from foreign financial institutions for domestic investment.
